title: 第23章 他到底多强第24章 同境无敌
slug: 杂役都是仙帝你管这叫没落宗门
lines: 然而，他们不敢，不代表别人不敢。
林玄的声音不大，但在灵力的加持下，任何人都能清楚听到，包括那正在交战的冥骨与苍鹤。
二人一愣，显然没想到，居然有人敢这时候跳出来。
相继停手，纷纷看向声音来源处，一袭白衣的林玄映入眼帘。
冥骨与苍鹤没想到，其他人更是没想到，还真有人不怕死，敢这么跟二人说话？
当看到开口之人居然便是先前一句话让楚月婵让出内圈席位的林玄时，他们眼神更是无比怪异。
这家伙，到底是什么情况？
先是匪夷所思的一句话，让剑败王境的楚月婵主动让出内圈席位，如今又是……
“小子，你说什么？”
冥骨眼神冰冷，在察觉到林玄身上的气息，不过劫境九重时，心中更是杀意暴起。
“看来，是听不懂人话。”
林玄话落，在众人惊诧的目光下，豁然斩出一剑！
剑罡如虹，划破长空，迅若惊雷！
只听嗡的一声，漫天剑罡，已然将冥骨老人淹没。
然后，便没了然后……
当剑罡散去，半空之上，哪还有冥骨老人的身影？
连带着气息，都永远的消散在天地之间。
留下的，只有骇然的众人，包括那位此前与冥骨交战的元明宗苍鹤。
他怎么也没想到，那与他纠缠多年，他想尽办法都想将对方除掉的冥骨老人，就这么陨落了……
被人，一剑斩了。
所有人看向林玄的目光，如同在看怪物一般。
可不就是怪物么。
现在他们才是终于明白，为何此前楚月婵要给林玄让位……
一切都解释得通了。
原来是这样，原来是这样啊！
“我不希望，此地再发生任何打斗。”
收剑，林玄这话，不仅是对苍鹤所说，也是对在场所有人的警告，要打可以，别在这里，否则下场就如那冥骨老人一般。
一股寒意自心底升腾而起，苍鹤整个人都是麻的，还好他性格不如冥骨那般暴躁，不过此前，他也对林玄的话十分不满，一个劫境九重，居然敢这般跟他们说话。
原本也打算对林玄发难的他，却是晚了冥骨一步……
如今想来，后怕不已。
好险，差一点死的就是自己了……
冥骨都接不住的一剑，苍鹤不觉得自己能够接下。
朝林玄一拜过后，苍鹤又回到了原本属于自己的位置。
这下，枯木周围总算是安静了下来，甚至可以说是落针可闻，生怕发出一丝动静，惊扰了林玄这个怪物。
“他到底多强？”
楚月婵心情复杂。
这小小的映月七国，怎会出现这等怪物？
此时的林玄在她心里，就如同无底洞一般，深不可测。
当你以为这便是他的极限时，林玄却用自己的行动证明，那只不过只是他的冰山一角。
继一剑击败自己后，他又一剑击败了一位王境二重圆满……
content_en:
However, just because they don't dare, doesn't mean others don't.
Lin Xuan's voice was not loud, but with the blessing of spiritual power, anyone could hear it clearly, including the fighting Nether Bones and Cang He.
The two of them were stunned, obviously not expecting that someone would dare to jump out at this time.
They stopped one after another and looked at the source of the sound. Lin Xuan, dressed in white, came into view.
Minggu and Canghe didn't expect, and the others didn't expect that there were really people who were not afraid of death and dared to talk to them like this?
When they saw that the person who spoke was actually Lin Xuan, who had told Chu Yuechan to give up his seat in the inner circle, their eyes were even more weird.
What's going on with this guy?
First, it was an unbelievable sentence that made Chu Yuechan, who was in the Sword Defeat King realm, voluntarily give up her seat in the inner circle, and now it’s...
"Boy, what did you say?"
Ming Gu's eyes were cold, and when he noticed the aura on Lin Xuan's body, which was at the ninth level of the Tribulation Realm, murderous intent arose in his heart.
"It seems that you can't understand people's words."
After Lin Xuan finished speaking, under the astonished gazes of everyone, he suddenly struck out with a sword!
The sword is as bright as a rainbow, piercing the sky as fast as thunder!
There was only a buzzing sound, and the sky was filled with swords and swords, which had already engulfed Old Man Minggu.
Then, it disappeared and then...
When the sword dissipated, where was the figure of Old Man Minggu still in the air?
Even the breath is forever dissipated between heaven and earth.
All that was left was the shocked crowd, including Cang He of the Yuan Ming Sect who had previously fought against Ming Gu.
He never expected that the old man with bones, whom he had been entangled with for many years and whom he tried every means to get rid of, would die like this...
He was killed with a sword.
Everyone looked at Lin Xuan as if they were looking at a monster.
Isn't it just a monster?
Now they finally understand why Chu Yuechan had to give way to Lin Xuan...
Everything makes sense.
So that’s it, that’s it!
"I don't want any more fighting to happen here."
Sheath your sword, Lin Xuan's words are not only to Cang He, but also a warning to everyone present. If you want to fight, you can fight, but not here, otherwise you will end up like the old man with dark bones.
A chill rose from the bottom of his heart, and Cang He's whole body was numb. Fortunately, his personality was not as violent as Ming Gu, but before that, he was also very dissatisfied with Lin Xuan's words. A ninth-level Tribulation Realm dared to talk to them like this.
He originally planned to attack Lin Xuan, but he was a step too late...
Now that I think about it, I am very scared.
It was so dangerous, I was the one who almost died...
Canghe didn't think he could catch a sword that even his bones could not catch.
After bowing to Lin Xuan, Canghe returned to his original position.
At this time, the surroundings of the dead wood finally became quiet, and it could even be said that you could hear a needle drop, for fear that a slight movement would disturb the monster Lin Xuan.
"How strong is he?"
Chu Yuechan felt complicated.
How could such monsters appear in this small Seven Kingdoms of Yingyue?
At this time, Lin Xuan was like a bottomless pit in her heart, unfathomable.
Just when you thought this was his limit, Lin Xuan proved with his actions that it was just the tip of the iceberg.
After defeating himself with one sword, he defeated a second-level King of Perfection with another sword...
title_en: Chapter 23 How strong is he? Chapter 24 Invincible in the same situation
